annotations.title: Ships expected at a port (API key)

description: Ships that have not arrived yet at one port, from the port's own records: estimated arrival and departure (UTC), berth and declared previous port, from 6 hours ago to 14 days ahead, in arrival order. Available for Finnish ports; elsewhere the list is empty. Get the port_id from find_port. Needs an AIS Trail API key sent by the MCP client as the HTTP header 'Authorization: Bearer ap_live_…' and a plan with live data (Pro or Business); at most 200 ships per call, 1 credit per ship returned.
